why_this_exists: Step 301 established that an edge at this scale, if one exists, lives where institutional capacity constraints bite rather than in the most arbitraged cross-section on earth. All nineteen closed families were tested on US equities. Indonesia is the one market already on disk that fits the other description.
what_the_earlier_closure_actually_said: The Indonesia/IDX80 programme was recorded as 'rejected or inconclusive because local inactive/delisted history, benchmark, cost, and forward gates remain open'. That is a closure on DATA GATES, not a measured null -- cross-sectional skill was never tested. This tests it.

data_and_its_limits.membership: data/indonesia_idx80_extended_history_vintages, point-in-time with effective_from, effective_to and available_at. 2019-02-01 to 2026-08-03, 157 distinct tickers against an 80-name index, so names that LEFT the index are present and the roster is survivorship-aware.
data_and_its_limits.fundamentals: none usable on disk, so this is a price-signal screen only and no valuation or quality signal is tested
data_and_its_limits.known_gap: the inactive/delisted price supplement is 516KB and may not cover every exit. An issuer that left the index AND lost price coverage is invisible, and that absence is not random -- it biases upward.

signals_declared.momentum_12_1: 52-week return excluding the most recent 4 weeks -- the protocol's own primary signal
signals_declared.low_volatility_26w: negative of 26-week return volatility -- the protocol's own secondary signal
signals_declared.short_term_reversal_4w: negative of the trailing 4-week return, as a control from a family closed on US data in Step 250
signals_declared.size_proxy: negative of the trailing 52-week median price, a crude small-size tilt, as a second control

bonferroni: 0.05/4 = 0.0125, stacked on every configuration searched across 301 steps
decision_cadence: monthly, matching the protocol's declared monthly decisions
the_measure_that_matters: monotonicity, with the Step 298 density guard. A signal whose deciles do not order themselves has no cross-sectional content whatever its extremes did.

declared_reading.worth_pursuing: monotonicity above 0.5 with interpretable deciles AND a rank IC clearing Bonferroni with a consistent decile spread sign
declared_reading.closes_it: monotonicity near zero, as every US signal has shown
declared_reading.inconclusive: fewer than 20 usable decisions, or a universe too thin to form ten deciles

no_strategy_can_come_out_of_this: A signal that scores here earns its own pre-registered test with a cost ladder and a short-sale feasibility check, not a book.
known_weaknesses_declared_up_front: About 80 names per period gives deciles of 8, which is thin. Decile statistics on 8 names are noisy and the monotonicity measure is the more robust of the three for that reason.
Indonesian equities carry wide spreads and thin liquidity; nothing here models cost, and a positive result would need the full cost ladder before it meant anything.
Roughly 90 monthly decisions over 2019-2026 is better than the 13-14 Step 296 warned about but still modest.
The window includes the 2020 crash and a commodity cycle that dominates Indonesian large caps; a single-regime result should be labelled as one.
